sections.name: File setup, groq
sections.title: Loading settings and the AI client
sections.what: Loads the settings file, reads the Groq key, and prepares the AI client, the same way the parser test does.
sections.why: Likely reason: copied setup so the script can call Groq directly.
sections.watch_out: The script exits if the key is missing.

sections.name: testEndToEndVoiceToAutoFill (part 1)
sections.title: Choosing instructions for each form type
sections.what: Picks the instruction text for an internship, hackathon, goal or task. Each text lists the fields that form expects, so the AI returns matching data.
sections.why: Likely reason: each form needs a different structure, so each gets its own instructions.
sections.watch_out: These instructions are written out again rather than shared with the live server route, so they may not match what the app does. A variable named promptAction is set but never used.

sections.name: testEndToEndVoiceToAutoFill (part 2)
sections.title: Sending spoken text to the AI and printing the result
sections.what: Sends the transcript with the chosen instructions to Groq, then prints the form values the AI returns.
sections.why: Likely reason: simulates the step where a user taps Auto-Fill after speaking.
sections.watch_out: The reply is parsed with JSON.parse with no protection, so a malformed reply stops the run. Only typed text is tested, not the microphone.

sections.name: main
sections.title: Running the three voice examples
sections.what: Runs three sample transcripts through the form filling check: a hackathon, an internship, and a goal.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: one example per form type.
sections.watch_out: Results are only printed, and a failed call stops the remaining examples.

summary: A manual script that simulates speaking an entry, then sends the spoken text to Groq to fill in an internship, hackathon, goal or task form.
purpose: Check that spoken text, after auto-fill, gives sensible form values.
why: Likely reason: to test the voice and auto-fill flow without a microphone. Reason not stated in the code.
how: 1. Reads the Groq key from the settings file. 2. Picks instructions that match the form type. 3. Sends the transcript to Groq. 4. Parses the reply and prints the form values. 5. Runs three sample transcripts in order.
inputs: Sample spoken sentences written in the script, the form type for each, and the Groq key.
outputs: Console printout only. Nothing is saved.
risks: Each example is a paid AI call. The instructions are copies and may not match the live app. Invalid JSON from the AI stops the run.
debug: Compare the printed fields with the fields the app's forms expect. If results differ from the app, check the server route's instructions. Confirm the Groq key is set.
